title: Ya Fatema Hussain ka pursaa qubool ho
body:
Ya Fatema Hussain ka pursaa qubool ho
<<DIVIDER>>
Qalb-e-Nabi ke chaen ka pursaa qubool ho
Hyder ke Noor-e-Ain ka pursaa qubool ho
Maula-e-mashraqain ka pursaa qubool ho
Zainab ke shor-o-shain ka pursaa qubool ho
<<MINI>>
Ya Fatema Hussain ka pursaa qubool ho
<<DIVIDER>>
Maatam hai Karbala may Mohammad ki aal ka
Qasim jari ka Akbar-e-Yousuf Jamaal ka
Abbas-e-zee viqaar ka Bano ke laal ka
Kunba aseer-e-gham hai shahey khush khisaal ka
<<MINI>>
Ya Fatema Hussain ka pursaa qubool ho
<<DIVIDER>>
Pyaase galay pe khanjar-e-bedaad jab chalaa
Jalti zameen pe thaa tanay besar Hussain ka
Maabainay aasmaan-o-zameen hashr tha bapaa
Rothay thay Ahlebait qayamat ka shore thaa
<<MINI>>
Ya Fatema Hussain ka pursaa qubool ho
<<DIVIDER>>
Maqtal may so rahey thay shaheedaan-e-Karbala
Bey aasraa tha in may aseeraan-e-Karbala
Farsh-e-aza bana tha biyabaan-e-Karbala
Kya shaam thi woh shaam-e-ghareeban-e-Karbala
<<MINI>>
Ya Fatema Hussain ka pursaa qubool ho
<<DIVIDER>>
Jab kar chukay Hussain ka chehlum aseer-e-gham
Dekha jo mehmiloun ko ronay lagay haram
Baar-e-gham-e-Hussain sey utt tha na tha qadam
Boli yeh sar ko peet ke Zainab ba chashm-e-namm
<<MINI>>
Ya Fatema Hussain ka pursaa qubool ho
<<DIVIDER>>
Maatam se shaahey deen ka abhi jee nahin bharaa
Mausam gham-e-Hussain ka pal may guzar gayaa
Har lamha zindagi sey rahega yehi gilaa
Haq toh yeh hai ke hum se adaa haq na ho sakaa
<<MINI>>
Ya Fatema Hussain ka pursaa qubool ho
<<DIVIDER>>
Ya Rab gham-e-Hussain malay hayaat ho
Yeh saans jab talak chalay seenay pay haath ho
Ashk-e-gham-e-Hussain hi raahey najaath ho
Lab par yehi fughaan rahey din ho ke raat ho
<<MINI>>
Ya Fatema Hussain ka pursaa qubool ho
<<DIVIDER>>
Seenay pa daag-e-maatam-e-Shabbir hai ayaan
Chashm-e-aza sey hotha hai khoon-e-jigar ravaan
Jab takh fareed hai yeh zameen aur aasmaan
Hontoun pa taa ba hashr rahegi yehi fughaan
<<MINI>>
Ya Fatema Hussain ka pursaa qubool ho
